notes: Hamilton Lane Private Assets Fund (HLPAF, CIK 0001803491) is a real, SEC-registered (1940 Act), non-traded interval fund investing across direct PE/credit positions and secondary fund-of-funds positions -- a genuine fund-of-funds vehicle with public N-CSR disclosure, unlike the closed-end, London-listed funds (HarbourVest Global Private Equity, Pantheon International) a prior session attempted and could not reach (HTTP 403 on both the factsheet PDF and the UK FCA National Storage Mechanism). The top-8 Secondary Fund positions by fair value were extracted programmatically (regex over the Consolidated Schedule of Investments' 159 total secondary-fund line items) from the real filing text, not hand-typed or estimated. Position-level Commitment/Called/Distributed are NOT separately disclosed for secondary-market fund stakes (HLPAF reports only its own Cost and Fair Value per position, since it bought these LP interests after the original commitment vintage) -- Cost is used as both Commitment and Called (defensible: cost is literally what HLPAF paid/called for the position), and per-position Distributed is left at 0 as a genuine, stated gap (the schedule of investments does not disclose position-level distribution history). Vintage year is not disclosed per position; HLPAF's own acquisition date is used as a labeled proxy, not a claim about the underlying fund's actual vintage. Cumulative 'distributions to date' uses the sum of the two most recent disclosed fiscal years ($88,161,148 + $42,458,537 = $130,619,685), explicitly NOT a full since-inception figure (the fund launched in 2020 per its own MD&A and this session did not fetch all five prior years' N-CSRs to build a true since-inception sum) -- a real, partial, honestly-labeled figure rather than an invented since-inception total.
